## What changed?

Describe the problem and the smallest useful change that solves it.

## Why?

Explain the user, contributor, security or architectural reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests
- [ ] I ran `npm run test:security` when security-sensitive behavior changed
- [ ] I did not add credentials, private documents, production identifiers or signing material
- [ ] I considered local/offline behavior
- [ ] I documented any new remote data boundary or provider configuration
- [ ] I updated documentation when behavior or setup changed

## Screenshots or recordings

Include these for meaningful UI changes when useful.

## Notes for reviewers

Call out migrations, compatibility concerns, security implications, follow-up work or areas where focused review would help.
